ShortDescription.Value: View information about asset meshes in-game

Publish.LongDescription:
# Mesh Stats Viewer View information about asset meshes in-game.
Ever wanted to check whether a 3D asset is poorly optimized, missing LODs or just standing there making your game cry? With this mod, you can do at least two of those things.
- The data is viewable when selecting an asset in-game, on the vanilla Selected Info Panel's Customization tab. - Includes option for customizable toleration of LOD tris and volumes so that you can control exactly what should be considered "heavy" for you. - By default, data view is disabled for vanilla assets but can be enabled from the Options menu.
Originally created at the request of MayorCheeks.
Publish.ChangeLog: - Public release. - Warnings with Cheeky mode enabled now shows the emojis on the right side of the text.
